notes.title: 【FREE MANGA PROJECT】 Past of Edrona and Vasilia: The Perpetual Stage
notes.content:
[h1]
[b]The past of Edrona and Vasilia, revealed![/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=9lYk14V20WE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Under the lights of the gorgeous Chursey stage, there are two famous chiefs, Edrona, a singer with an outstanding singing ability, and Vasilia, a tamer who is said to be able to conquer any beast.
The audience always enjoys the glamorous performance on stage, their tragic past, has never been mentioned by anyone.
